children: Global Gp Llc, acting as an insider, purchased common units representing limited partner interests in multiple transactions. The reporting person bought a total of 15,000 shares at weighted average prices of $52.20, $50.89 and $50.55 in the respective transactions. The total purchase amount reported is $768,200. Global Gp Llc directly owns 161,584 common units following the reported transactions. Global Gp Llc states the purchases were made to satisfy obligations under the Global Partners LP Long-Term Incentive Plan and disclaims any pecuniary interest in the securities.
